g.title: Backend-for-frontend that provides a GraphQL API for historical portfolio queries, supporting point-in-time portfolio snapshots, transaction history, and balance lookups.
The immutable financial ledger that records every transaction, position change, and valuation as append-only entries, serving as the single source of truth for portfolio accounting.
Reconciles broker-reported positions and transactions against the internal ledger, detecting discrepancies, flagging mismatches, and emitting reconciliation status events for cross-domain visibility.
Ingests cross-domain events from the execution bus into the ledger domain bus, subscribing to order fills, deposit and withdrawal completions, corporate actions, and portfolio snapshots.
